selected_problem: Fresh-main reproduction found staged preimages are captured as raw bytes but apply/rollback decoded them through UTF-8 text before writing. A non-UTF8 regular file could therefore be changed and then rolled back to different bytes, violating byte-exact reversibility.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: Fresh-main reproduction isolated one evidence-rich central transactional reversibility bottleneck. The committed four-mode router's singular-bottleneck gate therefore routes the replay to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT; no forced rotation was used.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt or fabricated numeric DWAC score is claimed.

pre_fix_reproduction.fixture: Existing asset.bin bytes ff fe 00 80 41 c3 28, then stage text replacement, apply, rollback.
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: Rollback produced 15 bytes with UTF-8 replacement sequences instead of the original 7 bytes.

changes: WorkspaceService.write now preserves Buffer/Uint8Array inputs byte-exactly while retaining UTF-8 semantics for string inputs.
Transactional apply and rollback write decoded changeset payload buffers directly instead of converting through UTF-8 text.
Added a focused regression proving non-UTF8 preimage bytes are restored exactly.

validation.pre_fix_observation: Focused fresh-main reproduction failed byte equality; 7 original bytes became 15 replacement-sequence bytes.

truth_boundaries: This closes deterministic byte corruption caused by UTF-8 round-tripping of staged binary preimages; it does not claim crash-level filesystem atomicity.
Agent-authored write payloads are still text-oriented at stage input; this change is about preserving stored changeset bytes and rollback fidelity.
OS-level validation sandboxing, arbitrary complex semantic synthesis, Windows descendant-tree equivalence, and crash-level filesystem atomicity remain unresolved.
No GitHub Actions are intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push is used, and no credential, payment, formal Release, or destructive/irreversible external action is performed.
